QuestInfo.name: Spiritual Power 1
QuestInfo.0: Moonbeam claims says that you can use the Blessings of the Fairy now that you have the Blessings of the Fox God. Talk to Moonbeam for more details.
QuestInfo.2: Moonbeam claims says that you can use the Blessings of the Fairy now that you have the Blessings of the Fox God. Sure enough, you can see [Fox Trot] and [Spirit Bond] in your skill window.

yes.0: Well then, for the next one I will teach you other skills, not just those for attacking.
